children: New Delhi, Sept. 10 -- The Delhi High Court has restrained home-care startup BECO from running an advertising campaign that allegedly linked Hindustan Unilever Ltd's (HUL) Vim and Surf Excel products to skin irritation and allergies, in an oral order passed on Thursday.
"I am injunctioning your ad campaign" said Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhami.

title: Delhi High Court restrains startup BECO from running ads against HUL products
